name: Service Dependency Failure
description: Redis becomes unavailable. The checkout API starts and serves health checks, but fails with ECONNREFUSED when attempting to fetch cart data from Redis.

production_error.stack_trace:
Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.1.5:6379
    at TCPConnectWrap.afterConnect [as oncomplete] (node:net:1595:16)
    at Redis._connect (/app/node_modules/ioredis/built/Redis.js:206:14)

root_cause.summary: The Redis service that the checkout API depends on became unavailable. All requests requiring cart data from Redis fail with ECONNREFUSED.
root_cause.details: The checkout-api service is configured to connect to Redis at redis:6379 for session and cart data storage. The Redis instance is not running or not reachable, causing all connection attempts to fail immediately with ECONNREFUSED. This is a service topology issue — the application has a hard dependency on Redis availability.
root_cause.suggested_fix:
1. Verify the Redis service is running: docker compose ps redis
2. Check Redis health: redis-cli -h redis ping
3. If Redis crashed, restart it and investigate the crash cause.
4. Consider adding a circuit breaker or graceful degradation for Redis unavailability.
